_README: What each pinned chart says it is, recorded so that a change is visible. check-chart-deprecation.py compares upstream against this on a schedule; the blocking gate only checks that every pin has a record and every record a pin. A description change means the chart redescribed itself — read the upstream notes before running --sync, because that is the signal a chart has changed product or maintainer without ever setting a deprecated flag.
